name: Temporal Plugin for Claude Code
summary: Official MIT Claude Code plugin (Public Preview) from Temporal, with skills for app development, observability, ops, serverless workers and Cloud setup.
description: temporalio/claude-temporal-plugin is the official Claude Code plugin for working with Temporal — developing applications, using the CLI, managing a server, and working with Temporal Cloud. Official LICENSE is MIT. The repository is not archived; created 2026-02-02 and last pushed 2026-11-24T14:26:00Z (2026-11-24 15:26:00 Europe/Stockholm). Official README marks the plugin as Public Preview and says it will continue to evolve. Official What's Included: temporal-developer (workflows, activities, workers, signals, queries, updates, non-determinism, saga patterns, versioning and testing across Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs); temporal-observability (metrics, dashboards and alerting for Temporal Cloud, self-hosted service and SDKs); temporal-ops (administering Temporal Cloud or self-hosted environments with the temporal and tcld CLIs); temporal-serverless (deploying Temporal Workers on AWS Lambda or GCP Cloud Run); and temporal-cloud-setup, which official wording says runs only when you invoke /temporal:temporal-cloud-setup and asks before each step. Official README: skill content is derived from temporalio/skill-temporal-developer, which can be installed alone if only the skill is needed; sibling official repos are named for Cursor (temporalio/cursor-temporal-plugin) and OpenAI Codex (temporalio/codex-temporal-plugin) and are not this listing. Documented `/plugin marketplace add temporalio/claude-temporal-plugin` and `/plugin install temporal@temporal-marketplace` were not executed. Temporal Cloud or other paid Temporal usage is separate and was not purchased.

agent_access.notes: Public MIT GitHub plugin marked Public Preview on the official README. No hosted MCP endpoint is documented on this repository.
